overview.heading: What pizzas are on the Wetherspoons menu?
overview.body:
The listed Wetherspoons pizza menu offers {itemCount} choices, with clear differences in sauce, toppings and dietary labels. [Margherita Pizza](/pizza/margherita-pizza) keeps to tomato sauce and mozzarella, while [Pepperoni Pizza](/pizza/pepperoni-pizza) adds savoury, slightly spicy sliced pepperoni. Hawaiian Pizza takes a different route with Wiltshire cured ham and pineapple. Those three give you a useful starting point: simple cheese, pepperoni, or a sweet and savoury topping combination.

For a more heavily topped choice, compare [BBQ Chicken Pizza](/pizza/bbq-chicken-pizza), Spicy Meat Feast Pizza and Chicken & Rib Meat Pizza. The barbecue option uses smoky BBQ sauce rather than the traditional tomato base. Spicy Meat Feast combines several meats with roquito peppers, while Chicken & Rib Meat pairs spicy chicken strips with pulled pork rib meat. Vegetarian and vegan vegetable options complete the selection.

Before choosing Margherita Pizza or Pepperoni Pizza, check the size attached to that particular listing rather than assuming all pizzas have the same diameter or that every recipe has a smaller version.

Size and topping choice answer different questions. An eight-inch format gives you a smaller diameter; BBQ Chicken Pizza and Chicken & Rib Meat Pizza describe different topping combinations, not confirmed portion weights. If you are comparing value, match like with like: the same size, the stated toppings and any extras actually included. The supplied information does not establish accompanying [sides](/sides), so check those separately rather than treating them as part of the pizza.

overview.heading: Which Wetherspoons pizza toppings should I choose?
overview.body:
Choose your Wetherspoons pizza by sauce and flavour first: tomato-based classics, smoky barbecue, spicy meat or vegetable toppings. BBQ Chicken Pizza combines BBQ sauce, mozzarella, roasted chicken breast and bacon. Spicy Meat Feast Pizza uses tomato sauce and mozzarella with pepperoni, chicken, bacon, spicy sausage and roquito peppers. For someone specifically seeking heat, the latter has the clearest spicy topping description.

Roasted Vegetable Pizza offers tomato sauce, mozzarella, roasted peppers and courgettes. Vegan Roasted Vegetable Pizza instead uses a vegan-friendly cheese alternative, with tomato sauce and roasted peppers among its listed ingredients. The vegan description is incomplete, so do not assume its full vegetable mix matches the vegetarian version. Hawaiian Pizza is the clearest choice for pineapple, while Margherita Pizza suits someone who wants fewer topping decisions.

The general club information relates to Curry Club on Thursday and Steak Club on Tuesday at participating pubs, often with a drink included. It does not establish a pizza club day or extend those arrangements to BBQ Chicken Pizza or any other pizza. If a local offer is displayed, read its conditions before ordering. Compare the total for the food and drink you actually want, rather than selecting an offer purely because it is presented as a deal.

overview.heading: Are there seasonal Wetherspoons pizza choices?
overview.body:
No seasonal or rotating pizza is identified in the supplied menu information. The named selection includes Margherita Pizza, Pepperoni Pizza, Hawaiian Pizza and the vegetable and meat-topped choices described here. Treat these as the listed range, not a promise that every pub will offer every item when you visit. Any additional topping or temporary recipe needs checking against the current local menu.

A useful approach is to choose a preferred pizza and an alternative with a similar flavour profile. If you want tomato sauce and meat, compare Pepperoni Pizza with Chicken & Rib Meat Pizza, noting the latter's spicy chicken and pulled pork. For plant-based eating, look specifically for Vegan Roasted Vegetable Pizza rather than assuming an unfamiliar vegetable special is vegan. Check its dietary label and full description before substituting it for your original choice.

bestChoices.title: Best for spicy toppings
bestChoices.text: Spicy Meat Feast Pizza has the clearest heat-focused description, combining pepperoni, chicken, bacon, spicy sausage and roquito peppers. Choose it for a varied meat topping rather than the simpler sliced pepperoni option.

bestChoices.title: Best for a meat-focused meal
